derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical connectivity only; emits directed identifier pairs without asserting sameness or distinctness.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every commercial relationship thread compiled from CRM account id and contract filename stem yields the full cross-product of crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifiers required for Purpose B connectivity.
derivations.required_premise: Source-native account ids, billed names, contract stems, and registry company numbers are present in their respective mechanical relations.
derivations.optional_enrichment: None; thread grouping uses filename/account-id correspondence heuristics only.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Filters invoice rows where source status equals open; no purpose policy.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is all invoice tuples; output cardinality equals count of invoices with status='open'.
derivations.required_premise: invoice.status is populated verbatim from billing sources.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps resolved contract_in_force dispositions to boolean active; omits UNRESOLVED contracts rather than defaulting false.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Only contracts with disposition IN_FORCE or EXPIRED appear; UNRESOLVED lifecycle judgments are absent from the projection.
derivations.required_premise: contract_in_force.disposition is IN_FORCE or EXPIRED for rows to materialize.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_term and contract_section ground lifecycle adjudication upstream but are not read directly by this projection.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Contract omitted from contract_in_force_active; downstream purposes must treat missing active as blocking, not false.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emits dependent only when current commercial relationship AND at least one qualifying obligation kind are confidently established; otherwise unresolved. Never emits a false-negative dependent=false row.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One row per contract/counterparty thread that is dependent or must be reported unresolved when identity or lifecycle inputs block assessment.
derivations.required_premise: Joint test: (open invoice in thread OR active contract with auto_renewal/rolling_term PRESENT) AND at least one of exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term is PRESENT in clause_presence.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_candidate_pair and invoice tuples locate open invoices and counterparty identifiers within threads when commercial_dependency rows are not pre-materialized.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Forces status unresolved even when invoices and obligations appear present.
Blocks asserting active renewing contract limb of current-relationship test; may still emit unresolved when open invoices exist.
Blocks obligation_kinds population and prevents dependent status.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Absence of PRESENT is not evidence of absence; does not assert non-dependency, only withholds dependent.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Includes invoice rows tied to an active contract bearing at least one acquisition-relevant clause; association field is asserted or unresolved, never omitted when inclusion criteria met.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage for invoices qualifying under active-contract plus acquisition-clause policy, or requiring unresolved association when join evidence is insufficient.
derivations.required_premise: contract_in_force resolves IN_FORCE (or contract_in_force_active.active=true) AND clause_presence.disposition=PRESENT for at least one Purpose A acquisition-relevant kind on the governing contract in the invoice thread.
derivations.optional_enrichment: When invoice_contract_association is absent, identity_judgment SAME_ENTITY between billing: and contract: identifiers may upgrade association to asserted; otherwise association defaults to unresolved.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Blocks active-contract premise; invoice excluded from output even if acquisition clauses would otherwise qualify.
No acquisition-clause evidence available; no Purpose A rows emitted.
Does not block inclusion; row emitted with association=unresolved.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Prevents asserted association but does not block row when other required premises hold and association policy allows unresolved reporting.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects identity judgments to directed links with epistemic SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED; similarity alone never implies SAME_ENTITY.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: When identity_judgment is empty, falls back to identity_candidate_pair universe with epistemic UNRESOLVED for every required connectivity link.
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuple exists for each emitted link when semantic adjudication has been loaded into world.
derivations.optional_enrichment: identity_candidate_pair supplies the connectivity universe when judgments are not persisted in world.sqlite.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Emitted as epistemic UNRESOLVED; does not suppress the link row.
Candidate pairs still emitted with epistemic UNRESOLVED per completeness policy.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projects commercial_dependency rows to Purpose C JSON; status is dependent or unresolved only.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: When commercial_dependency is not materialized, synthesizes unresolved rows for contract threads with open invoices or blocked assessments.
derivations.required_premise: commercial_dependency row exists, or fallback conjunction of current relationship and qualifying obligations can be evaluated from world inputs.
derivations.optional_enrichment: open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds enriched from open_invoice and clause_presence when commercial_dependency counterparty field is sparse.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Blocks dependent status from renewing-contract limb; row may still be unresolved with open invoices.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: Prevents dependent classification; emits unresolved when current relationship indicators exist.

limitations: Per 06_admission.json, Purpose relations (clause_presence, identity_judgment, invoice_contract_association, commercial_dependency) are not promoted into 06_world/world.sqlite; derive_purposes.py reads only world.sqlite and therefore cannot apply adjudicated dispositions from 05_dispositions.json.
Purpose A output is empty in the current world state because clause_presence is absent and contract_in_force is UNRESOLVED for all non-expired MSAs, blocking both required premises.
Purpose B links are emitted from identity_candidate_pair with epistemic UNRESOLVED because identity_judgment is not persisted in world.
Purpose C rows are unresolved with empty obligation_kinds because clause_presence and identity_judgment are absent; open_invoice_ids are populated mechanically from billing threads.
